description: A Photovoltaic System (1 kW) Data for Three Days is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Alper Nabi Akpolat (Marmara University). This dataset is created by an experimental setup of a DC-PV -Battery-based grid-connected distributed generation system. This dataset is split into four parts such as irradiance, and temperature, which were measured by a meteorological station, and lastly, PV output current and voltage acquired by an inverter. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
